subject: CAIQ attestation handoff and audit daybook coordination
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auditworks.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Request: CAIQ attestation & audit daybook for upcoming CSA review

Hi Sofia,

We're kicking off the CSA assessment for Redwood Inference on Oct 12 and want to assemble an "audit daybook" (timeline + artefacts) and collect completed CAIQ attestations ahead of the window. To keep this scoped and actionable, can you provide the following by COB next Tuesday (Oct 5)?

1) Completed CAIQ attestation template (we'll need a signed copy) — see attached attestation_template_redwood_v1.pdf
2) A CAIQ->control mapping spreadsheet showing where each assertion is covered in your environment (telemetry, policy, artifact location). If you have a crosswalk, send it; otherwise a short mapping is fine.
3) A 24-hour runtime telemetry sample (anonymized) showing token-level telemetry and retention marks; ideally a zipped sample and short README of fields.
4) Clarify retention policy for request logs, KV-cache snapshots, and error traces (we need retention windows and archival location).
5) Any IPs or SAML metadata we should whitelist for the live audit runbook.

If helpful, we can take the CAIQ draft and mark gaps during a 45-min walkthrough. Please let me know who will be the control owner(s) for this scope.

Thanks,
Liam
AuditWorks
[Attachment: attestation_template_redwood_v1.pdf]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auditworks.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ attestation & audit daybook for upcoming CSA review

Hi Liam,

Thanks — we can handle this. I've attached an initial CAIQ crosswalk (caiq_crosswalk_initial.xlsx) and the attestation template pre-filled for the majority of assertions. Quick plan:

- Today: Share crosswalk + attestation draft (attached).
- Tue (Oct 5): Kimberly to provide runtime telemetry sample and retention write-up.
- Wed (Oct 6): Internal review and DocuSign envelope prepared; Marissa to coordinate signatures and export final PDF.
- Oct 9: Final artifacts uploaded to Drive and DocuSign completed.

A couple of clarifying questions so we provide exactly what you need:
- For the telemetry sample, do you want full HTTP headers stripped, or a sanitized CSV of token telemetry only?
- For the CAIQ mapping, we'll include the column that points to artifact locations (Drive path + Jira ticket). Is that format okay?

I've CC'd Kimberly (runtime/instrumentation) and Marissa (legal/compliance) to own the technical evidence and signature workflow respectively.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: caiq_crosswalk_initial.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auditworks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-28T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ attestation & audit daybook for upcoming CSA review

Hi all,

Attaching the runtime log sample and a short README. Notes below that should map into the CAIQ crosswalk:

- Telemetry format: CSV with fields {timestamp, request_id, model_variant, tenant_id_hash, token_index, token_event, latency_ms}. PII is not present — tenant IDs are hashed. File: runtime-log-sample-20260801.zip (contains runtime-sample-20260801.csv + README.txt).
- Retention: hot telemetry retained 30 days in our telemetry DB (ClickHouse), aggregated traces pushed to cold storage (S3 glacier) at day 31 for 365 days archival; access via internal artifact gateway.
- KV cache snapshots: ephemeral snapshots are not persisted beyond node lifecycle; if persistent cache is used for dedicated deployments, snapshots are stored in customer-scoped S3 buckets per contract — we'll flag scope in the crosswalk.
- Control mappings (examples):
  * CAIQ-CI-2 (Logging): runtime telemetry + traceback stored in /audit/logs/runtime/; sampling CSV attached.
  * CAIQ-DS-4 (Data retention): retention window documented and automated lifecycle rule: S3 lifecycle -> 30d hot, 365d cold.
  * CAIQ-PL-1 (Policy): relevant policy doc in Drive (link in crosswalk).

I'll upload the artifacts to the Drive folder Sofia listed and link them in the crosswalk. If AuditWorks needs full headers for a specific control test, we can produce a redacted version under an NDA.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Engineering Manager, Observability
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runtime-log-sample-20260801.zip; README: runtime-log-sample-README.txt]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auditworks.io>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-28T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ attestation & audit daybook for upcoming CSA review

Liam,

Thanks for the timeline and Kimberly/Sofia for the artifacts. A couple of operational asks from our side to finalize the audit daybook:

- We'll prepare the final attestation and send the DocuSign envelope by EOD Sep 30. Please confirm the signing order (AuditWorks signer first or Redwood first).
- Can you provide the list of IP ranges (and preferred audit VM jumpbox addresses) you plan to use during the Oct 12 live session? We'll add them to our whitelist and submit the SAML metadata.
- For audit evidence referencing (to keep a clean daybook), please use these IDs when requesting artifacts: SEC-482 (runtime telemetry), SEC-483 (KV-cache proof), SEC-484 (retention lifecycle). We'll mirror those in the Drive manifest.

On Tue, Sep 27, 2026 at 11:12 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — we can handle this. I've attached an initial CAIQ crosswalk ...
> [quoted for context]

Marissa Cole
Legal & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none — DocuSign envelope to follow]
